# How to Find the Right Wholesale Vehicles Faster with OPENLANE Search & Filters


[Product + Tech](https://www.openlane.com/insights/category/product-tech/) |


- [Buying](https://www.openlane.com/insights/tag/buying/)
- [Dealer Operations](https://www.openlane.com/insights/tag/dealer-operations/)
- [Easy Mode](https://www.openlane.com/insights/tag/easy-mode/)


4 mins


Sep 29, 2026


Finding wholesale inventory isn’t usually the problem.


Finding the right inventory is.


With thousands of wholesale and off-lease listings available on OPENLANE, dealers have plenty of options. But when you’re sourcing for specific customer demand, filling a gap on your lot or working within a tight buying budget, you don’t have time to scroll through vehicles that don’t fit your strategy.


That’s where OPENLANE’s vehicle search and filters come in.


OPENLANE gives you tools to quickly narrow thousands of wholesale vehicles down to what matters to your dealership. You can filter by make, model, mileage, price, features, and inspection findings.


Here’s how to make them work harder for you.


## How does vehicle search work on OPENLANE?


OPENLANE’s vehicle search helps dealers quickly narrow available wholesale inventory based on the criteria that matter to them.


Start with the basics. Search by criteria such as:


- Make
- Model year
- Mileage
- Price range


From there, you can apply additional filters to get more specific, including preferences like color, fuel type, transmission and vehicle features.


Know exactly what you need? Add more criteria to create a highly targeted search.


Have some flexibility? Start broader and add filters as you go.


Either way, instead of searching inventory vehicle by vehicle, you can quickly create a shortlist that fits the needs of your lot.


## Which OPENLANE search filters should dealers use?


The best filters depend on what you’re trying to accomplish.


If you’re filling a specific inventory need, **make and model** can help you focus on the brands and vehicles you’re looking for.


Trying to maintain a certain type of vehicle? Use **year and mileage** ranges to zero in on vehicles that fit.


Working backward from your acquisition budget? Set a **minimum and maximum price range** to focus your search.


But one of the most useful tools goes beyond basic vehicle specs.


## Filter based on inspection findings


Vehicle condition is just as important as year, mileage, or price when deciding what to buy.


OPENLANE’s Inspection filters allow you to exclude vehicles based on issues identified during inspection, including transmission problems, engine noise, frame damage, rust and more.


That means you can decide how comfortable you are with wear and tear before you start looking for vehicles.


The result? Less time spent opening listings that aren’t right for your strategy and more time evaluating vehicles that could be.


## How can you get better vehicle search results?


More filters aren’t necessarily better.


The goal is to use the right combination of filters for the inventory you’re trying to find.


A few simple strategies can help:


**Start with your must-haves.** If year, mileage and acquisition price are non-negotiable, begin there.


**Add filters strategically.** Too many criteria can make a search unnecessarily narrow. Start with what’s most important and refine from there.


**Experiment with different combinations.** If you’re not finding enough options, adjust one criterion at a time to see what additional inventory becomes available.


**Use sorting to prioritize what matters.** Once you’ve narrowed your search, sorting your results can help bring the most relevant opportunities to the top.


And remember: OPENLANE inventory is continuously refreshed, so the vehicle that isn’t available today could show up tomorrow.


Which brings us to another way to make search work harder for you.


## Can you save vehicle searches on OPENLANE?


Yes. OPENLANE lets dealers save searches so they can quickly return to their preferred search criteria and see new vehicles that match.


Instead of rebuilding the same search every time you source inventory, save the criteria you use regularly.


Maybe you’re always looking for newer SUVs with low mileage. Or diesel trucks. Or vehicles from a particular make within a specific price range.


Build the search once. Save it. Then come back to see what’s new.


It’s a small step that can save valuable time when sourcing becomes part of your daily routine.


## How can you find newly listed vehicles that match your needs?


You don’t always have to go looking for them.


OPENLANE also lets dealers set alerts for saved search criteria. When new inventory matching those parameters becomes available, you can receive a notification.


That can be especially helpful when you’re sourcing a harder-to-find vehicle or trying to stay on top of a specific segment.


Think of it as putting your search to work even when you’re busy doing something else.


## Search smarter, not longer


When you’re buying wholesale, more inventory doesn’t automatically make sourcing easier.


The ability to quickly get from thousands of possibilities to the vehicles that fit your business does.


That’s ultimately what OPENLANE’s search experience is designed to do: cut through the noise.


Use filters to focus your results. Save the searches you use most. Set alerts for the inventory you don’t want to miss.


Then spend less time searching — and more time buying the right cars.

### **FAQs**


**How do I search for wholesale vehicles on OPENLANE?** **** Dealers can search OPENLANE inventory using criteria such as make, model, year, mileage and price, then apply additional filters to further narrow the results.


**What vehicle filters are available on OPENLANE?** **** OPENLANE offers dozens of filtering options, including make, model, year, mileage, price range, color, fuel type, transmission, vehicle features and inspection findings.


**Can I filter OPENLANE inventory based on vehicle condition?** **** Yes. Inspection filters can be used to exclude vehicles with identified issues such as engine noise, transmission problems, frame damage or rust.


**Can I save a vehicle search on OPENLANE?** **** Yes. Dealers can save preferred search criteria, making it easier to return to the same search and see new inventory that matches their needs.


**Can OPENLANE notify me when matching inventory becomes available?** **** Yes. Dealers can set alerts to receive notifications when vehicles matching their search parameters become available.
